# P31 Design System — Quantum Material

> A neurodivergent-first, sovereign design system. Dark-first glass, OKLCH tokens, spoon-aware. One source of truth: W3C DTCG. 32 components, each with a contract and a lifecycle tier.

## Foundations

- [Tokens (DTCG)](https://design.p31ca.org/tokens) — the full `p31.*` token tree, OKLCH, with dotted paths and values.
- [Tokens JSON](https://design.p31ca.org/tokens) — machine source: `@p31ca/canon/tokens/tokens.dtc.json`.
- Color, typography, spacing, motion, radius — see `/tokens` for the live explorer.

## Device tiers

Capability → tier, never device brand. Manifest contract:
`production/design-workflow/B-device-tiers/device-tiers.json` (+ resolver
`device-tiers.mjs` — pure ESM, zero deps, fail-closed).

- embedded — Node Zero (ESP32-S3 + LVGL): `windowSizeClass: null`, no pointer/hover,
  `touchTargetMin: 44`, `navigation: minimal-html`, `delivery: [embedded-css, lvgl-c]`,
  SPIFFS assets partition, budget ≤ 100 KB gzip (web) / ≤ 8 KB raw (`p31_theme.h`).
- mobile — compact (<600dp): coarse/none, 44px floor, bottom-nav, css-mobile, safe-area.
- tablet — medium (600–840dp): mixed/mixed, 44px floor, nav-rail, css-full, safe-area.
- desktop — expanded (≥840dp): fine/hover, 34px floor under pointer:fine ONLY, sidebar, css-full.

Rules: tiers are semantic value swaps, never component forks (subset, not fork);
320px litmus with @media disabled; 44px touch floor on coarse; `dvh`/`svh`, no bare
`100vh`; pointer/hover are independent flags — surfaced, never collapsed (a 1200px
coarse device is desktop WITH `flags.coarse: true`). Unknown capability values fail
closed (TypeError → ask a human, never a guess).

## Components

32 compositions in `@p31ca/design-core/compositions`, rendered live in the catalog.

- [Catalog](https://design.p31ca.org/catalog) — every component, grouped, live-rendered.
- [Playground](https://design.p31ca.org/playground) — live component lab + Intent DSL.
- [A2UI](https://design.p31ca.org/a2ui) — generative UI: intent → declarative data → rendered.

## Agents

- [AGENTS.md](https://design.p31ca.org/llms-full.txt) — the operating contract for agents building on the system (imports, token rule, the ten mistakes).
- DESIGN.md — machine-readable design context (YAML tokens + rationale), shipped in `@p31ca/design-core`.
- MCP server — `component_catalog`, `token_resolve`, `component_schema`, and composition tools.
- [Registry (JSON)](https://design.p31ca.org/catalog) — shadcn-style registry: `packages/design-core/registry.json`.

## Governance

- [Contributing](https://design.p31ca.org/llms-full.txt) — proposal → triage → review bar → lifecycle tiers.
- Lifecycle tiers: `core` (stable), `experimental` (additive), `deprecated` (retiring).
- Ten gates, each with a proven negative control, in `pnpm gate`.

## Package surface

- `@p31ca/canon` — tokens (`tokens.css`, `tokens.dtc.json`).
- `@p31ca/design-core` — components (`compositions`), CSS (`css/*`), contracts.
- Import: `import { GlassCard, Button } from '@p31ca/design-core/compositions'; import '@p31ca/canon/tokens.css';`
